## Functions

### `DescriptionList`

```ts
DescriptionList(props: DescriptionListProps): Html
```

Key–value pairs as a real `<dl>`: each pair is a `<div>` holding its
`<dt>` and `<dd>` (valid HTML, and what the grid layouts need). Terms
are the small-caps label style, descriptions the text colour.

## Types

### `DescriptionListLayout`

How term and description sit: `stacked` (term above its value),
`inline` (term in a fixed column, value beside it — a details panel),
`columns` (pairs in a responsive grid — an invoice's billed-from /
billed-to block, a settings summary).

- `"stacked"`
- `"inline"`
- `"columns"`

### `DescriptionListSize`

- `"sm"`
- `"md"`

### `DescriptionItem`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `term` | `string | Html` | yes | The key. |
| `description` | `string | Html` | yes | The value; figures get tabular numerals. |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  | Extra attributes on the pair's wrapper `<div>`; a `class` merges. |

### `DescriptionListProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `DescriptionItem[]` | yes |  |
| `layout` | `DescriptionListLayout` |  |  |
| `size` | `DescriptionListSize` |  |  |
| `divided` | `boolean` |  | A rule between pairs. |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  | Extra attributes on the `<dl>`; a `class` merges. |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### An invoice's details panel

```ts
DescriptionList({
  layout: "inline",
  divided: true,
  items: [
    { term: "Invoice", description: "INV-2048" },
    { term: "Client", description: "Northwind Traders" },
    { term: "Status", description: Badge({ label: "Paid", variant: "success", dot: true }) },
    { term: "Total", description: "$12,400.00" },
  ],
})
```

```html
<dl class="description-list description-list--inline description-list--divided">
  <div class="description-list__item">
    <dt class="description-list__term">Invoice</dt>
    <dd class="description-list__description">INV-2048</dd>
  </div>
  <div class="description-list__item">
    <dt class="description-list__term">Client</dt>
    <dd class="description-list__description">Northwind Traders</dd>
  </div>
  <div class="description-list__item">
    <dt class="description-list__term">Status</dt>
    <dd class="description-list__description">
      <span class="badge badge--success">
        <span class="badge__dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        Paid
      </span>
    </dd>
  </div>
  <div class="description-list__item">
    <dt class="description-list__term">Total</dt>
    <dd class="description-list__description">$12,400.00</dd>
  </div>
</dl>
```

### Billed from / billed to, side by side

```ts
DescriptionList({
  layout: "columns",
  items: [
    { term: "Billed from", description: "Acme Inc., 500 Market St, San Francisco" },
    { term: "Billed to", description: "Blue Bottle Co., 12 Ferry Building, San Francisco" },
  ],
})
```

```html
<dl class="description-list description-list--columns">
  <div class="description-list__item">
    <dt class="description-list__term">Billed from</dt>
    <dd class="description-list__description">Acme Inc., 500 Market St, San Francisco</dd>
  </div>
  <div class="description-list__item">
    <dt class="description-list__term">Billed to</dt>
    <dd class="description-list__description">Blue Bottle Co., 12 Ferry Building, San Francisco</dd>
  </div>
</dl>
```
